about: Source features that the evidence shows are wrong. 'exclude': they stay in the master dataset (flagged, confidence low) but are kept out of the game map; a feature is only excluded when independent evidence contradicts it. 'heights': storey counts and heights that reference photos contradict (the footprint is not touched). 'reclass': ground areas whose mapped use the reference photos and the owner contradict (the outline is kept). 'reshape': an outline that sits off the building Google Open Buildings and the owner's imagery show is replaced by a measured ring (game metres); the OSM id and tags stay.

exclude.reason: OSM building=yes + amenity=place_of_worship named 'lizalex' (8,486 m²) filling the strip between Elizabeth Sey Hall and Alexander Kwapong Hall. Google Open Buildings detects only small structures inside it and the Sentinel-2 composite shows open ground; no other source knows a church there. Treated as an erroneous edit.

reshape.reason: The OSM outline (a 65 m x 15 m rectangle) sits about 10 m north-west of the building: Google Open Buildings overlaps it by only 13%. Google's footprint (the 54 m long block with the round entrance building at its west end) matches the owner's layout photo of the school, scaled at 4.3 px/m: long block, rotunda and the south block land on their roofs.
